rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for a grandchild in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: My grandchild comes to my home for dinner every day.
example.traditional: 我個孫仔成日嚟我屋企食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 syun1 zai2 sing4 jat6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Speakers use this shorter, somewhat more formal term when the family relationship is already clear.

example.english: The inheritance will go to the grandchild.
example.jyutping: fan6 wai4 caan2 wui5 lau4 bei2 go3 syun1
